title: spring.config.import (nacos)
description: The nacos provider has no bound prefix; it is consumed via spring.config.import=optional:nacos:<host>:<port>/<data-id>?group=&namespace=&username=&password=&format=&timeout-ms=&retry-ms=

format.description: properties/yaml/json/toml; default inferred from the data-id extension, else properties

retry-ms.description: watcher retry interval in milliseconds; default 2000
